text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're pretty good at this.
You the type who practically lived at the arcade?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, to think someone so thrilling to mess around with was right here all along.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Now I'm getting fired up! Alright—let's set the terms of the match."
